pc.ready.text: Hi, I'm Yonder! Will you help me read maps and visit my pen pals?

pc.back.text: Welcome back, explorer! More postcards arrived.

pc.story.intro1.text: This is Yonder. Her shell is a little globe, covered in travel stickers.

pc.story.intro2.text: One morning, a whole bag of postcards arrived from pen pals around the world!

pc.story.intro3.text: Yonder wants to visit every one. But first, she needs to read a map.

pc.story.intro4.text: Zephy will fly the postcards. You read the map!

pc.story.between2.text: Two postcards in the bag! Where will the next one come from?

pc.story.between4.text: Look, this postcard came from far, far away!

pc.story.between6.text: Last few postcards. Yonder's shell is nearly full of stickers.

pc.story.outro2.text: You used the compass, the key and the map to find each place.

pc.story.outro3.text: Here's your Explorer Sticker for your shell!

pc.help.compass.text: On this map, north is at the top. Never Eat Soggy Waffles!

pc.help.opposite.text: Oops, that's the opposite way. Check the letters on the compass rose.

pc.help.turn.text: Find the letter on the compass rose first. Then press that button.

pc.help.route.text: Do the first direction, then the next. Count the steps as you go.

pc.help.edge.text: That's the edge of the island. Let's check the compass rose.

pc.help.key.text: A map key tells you what each little picture means.

pc.help.lookalike.text: Those two symbols look alike. Check the picture in the key carefully.

pc.help.grid.text: Go along to the letter, then up or down to the number.

pc.help.continent.text: A continent is a huge piece of land. Most continents have lots of countries.

pc.help.ocean.text: Five oceans, all joined together: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Arctic and Southern.

pc.help.worldcompass.text: On this map, north is up and south is down. Check the compass rose.

pc.help.side.text: Find the continent first. Then look at the water on that side.

pc.help.equator.text: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth.

pc.help.above.text: Places above the equator line are north. Places below it are south.

pc.help.season.text: When it's summer north of the equator, it's winter south of it.

pc.help.trip.text: Start at the balloon. Follow one arrow at a time to the next continent.

pc.help.land.text: That's land! Boats sail on the water.

pc.where.na.text: North America is on the left side, near the top.

pc.where.sa.text: South America is on the left side, below North America.

pc.where.europe.text: Europe is near the top, in the middle, just above Africa.

pc.where.africa.text: Africa is in the middle of the map, below Europe.

pc.where.asia.text: Asia is the biggest continent. It's at the top, on the right.

pc.where.australia.text: Australia is on the right, near the bottom, below Asia.

pc.where.antarctica.text: Antarctica is the icy land all along the bottom.

pc.where.pacific.text: The Pacific is the biggest ocean. It's on both edges of this map.

pc.where.atlantic.text: The Atlantic is between the Americas and Europe and Africa.

pc.where.indian.text: The Indian Ocean is below Asia, between Africa and Australia.

pc.where.arctic.text: The Arctic Ocean is at the very top, around the North Pole.

pc.where.southern.text: The Southern Ocean goes all the way around Antarctica.

pc.prompt.ocean.text: Sail the boat to the {ocean} Ocean.

pc.prompt.fly.text: Which way should Yonder fly to reach {to}?

pc.prompt.side.text: Yonder sails {dir} from {continent}. Which ocean is the boat in?

pc.prompt.hemi.text: Is {place} north or south of the equator?

pc.prompt.season.text: In {month}, is it summer or winter in {place}?

pc.prompt.trip.text: Start in {start}. Follow the arrows and put the postcards in order.

pc.prompt.cards.text: Post each card to its continent. Tap a card to hear it.

pc.card.canada.text: This postcard is from Canada, in North America. Where is North America?

pc.found.canada.text: You found North America! Many people in Canada skate on frozen lakes.

pc.card.usa.text: This postcard is from the United States, in North America. Where is North America?

pc.found.usa.text: You found North America! A river carved the Grand Canyon over millions of years.

pc.card.mexico.text: This postcard is from Mexico, in North America. Where is North America?

pc.found.mexico.text: You found North America! People in Mexico often eat tortillas made from corn.

pc.card.peru.text: This postcard is from Peru, in South America. Where is South America?

pc.found.peru.text: You found South America! People in Peru have grown potatoes for thousands of years.

pc.card.brazil.text: This postcard is from Brazil, in South America. Where is South America?

pc.found.brazil.text: You found South America! The Amazon rainforest is full of plants and animals.

pc.card.argentina.text: This postcard is from Argentina, in South America. Where is South America?

pc.found.argentina.text: You found South America! In Patagonia, giant glaciers slide slowly into lakes.

pc.card.france.text: This postcard is from France, in Europe. Where is Europe?

pc.found.france.text: You found Europe! The Eiffel Tower in Paris is made of iron.

pc.card.italy.text: This postcard is from Italy, in Europe. Where is Europe?

pc.found.italy.text: You found Europe! The Colosseum in Rome is almost two thousand years old.

pc.card.norway.text: This postcard is from Norway, in Europe. Where is Europe?

pc.found.norway.text: You found Europe! Fjords are deep, narrow bays carved out by glaciers.

pc.card.egypt.text: This postcard is from Egypt, in Africa. Where is Africa?

pc.found.egypt.text: You found Africa! The Great Pyramids are more than four thousand years old.

pc.card.kenya.text: This postcard is from Kenya, in Africa. Where is Africa?

pc.found.kenya.text: You found Africa! Many people in Kenya speak Swahili and English.

pc.card.southafrica.text: This postcard is from South Africa, in Africa. Where is Africa?

pc.found.southafrica.text: You found Africa! Table Mountain has a flat top, just like a table.

pc.card.madagascar.text: This postcard is from Madagascar, in Africa. Where is Africa?

pc.found.madagascar.text: You found Africa! Madagascar is a big island where lemurs live in the wild.

pc.card.japan.text: This postcard is from Japan, in Asia. Where is Asia?

pc.found.japan.text: You found Asia! People in Japan often eat rice and soup for breakfast.

pc.card.china.text: This postcard is from China, in Asia. Where is Asia?

pc.found.china.text: You found Asia! The Great Wall of China is thousands of miles long.

pc.card.india.text: This postcard is from India, in Asia. Where is Asia?

pc.found.india.text: You found Asia! Many people in India celebrate Diwali, the festival of lights.

pc.card.indonesia.text: This postcard is from Indonesia, in Asia. Where is Asia?

pc.found.indonesia.text: You found Asia! On Bali, farmers grow rice on steps cut into hills.

pc.card.sydney.text: This postcard is from Sydney, in Australia. Where is Australia?

pc.found.sydney.text: You found Australia! The Sydney Opera House roof looks like sails.

pc.card.reef.text: This postcard is from the Great Barrier Reef, in Australia. Where is Australia?

pc.found.reef.text: You found Australia! The Great Barrier Reef is the biggest coral reef on Earth.

pc.card.antarctica.text: This postcard is from a science station in Antarctica. Where is Antarctica?

pc.found.antarctica.text: You found Antarctica! Scientists live at stations there to study the ice.

pc.praise.compass.text: You used the compass rose, and Yonder got the postcard!

pc.praise.listen.text: You listened for the direction and found the way.

pc.praise.route.text: You followed every direction, step by step.

pc.praise.grid.text: Along, then up or down. Careful grid reading!

pc.praise.fly.text: You used the compass on the world map!

pc.praise.side.text: You looked at the right side of the continent.

pc.praise.season.text: You thought about the hemisphere. Great thinking!

pc.praise.trip.text: You followed every arrow, one stop at a time.

pc.praise.cards.text: You found every continent on the map!

pc.retry.text: Let's look at the map again.

pc.hint.model.text: Watch Zephy show the way. Then you try.

pc.idle.text: Take your time. Look at the map.

pc.walk.full.text: The plan is ready. Press Walk!
